extras.existing_zone: ZG; existing 3 mm magnified groove and keyboard remain procedural

extras.placement: hero offset only; frontend repositions to existing air zone

platter.absolute_angle: -s.ang; do not add canonical rest or integrate dt

tonearm.input: existing circle-intersection yaw, supplied explicitly; independent of platter phase

records.textures: Shared radial UV colour and roughness; physical metre UV mapping for both formats. Grooves are illustrative density, not an audio waveform. Lighting highlights are PBR, not painted into texture.
records.label: No baked rpm, frequencies or challenge answers. Frontend owns labels.

belt.geometry: Exact common external tangents and circular arcs; no torque or slip model.

interaction.note: Create a frontend invisible pick sphere and retain existing slider/keyboard fallback. Do not pick the tiny diamond geometry.

limitations: Generic educational construction; no manufacturing/physical device validation.
Estimated inertia remains .5*1.5*.15*.15 in the source; mesh geometry does not determine it.
